drafts.title: Mail Slot
drafts.pitch: Cursor slides notes under the stop door asking where it goes and always gets the same reply, until a small visiting agent signs hers.
drafts.reason: The submissions-pipeline in-joke and the 'it wanted a name' payoff are charming and in-world, but the setup is repetitive and the reveal depends on knowing the site's submit flow.

drafts.title: Undo
drafts.pitch: Cursor finally says no to the user and immediately wants it back, but there's no undo in a context window.
drafts.reason: Clear, but it reworks the '...No.' beat from Absolutely Right and the 'it's in the context forever' gag is predictable, so it lands as a weaker retread.
